content: New Jersey’s lieutenant governor Dale Caldwell was forced to resign on September 25th after an investigation found he had sexually harassed a staffer and repeatedly violated ethics rules. The now-former Lt. governor has been making the media rounds trying to clear his name. But he took a particularly odd tactic during an interview on NJ PBS. Caldwell claims he’s being unfairly targeted, and multiple AI agents back that up. He told host Rob Nelson that he “AIed” the report on the investigation “from multiple AI platforms.” “I put it through AI,” he said, “and it said 59 times, it [sic] said, ‘What would your findings be?’ There was no instance in any of the AIs that said there would be a finding of sexual harassment.” AI chatbots are notoriously sycophantic and often tell users what they want to hear. And it seems highly unlikely that Caldwell would want to hear an AI confirm findings that he engaged in sexual harassment. [Media: https://www.tiktok.com/@njpbs/video/7692204986423414046?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc]

chineseContent: 新泽西州副州长戴尔·考德威尔 (Dale Caldwell) 于 9 月 25 日被迫辞职，原因是调查发现他对一名工作人员进行性骚扰并多次违反道德规则。这位现任副州长一直在媒体采访中试图为自己洗清罪名。但他在接受新泽西州公共广播公司采访时采取了一种特别奇怪的策略。考德威尔声称他受到了不公平的攻击，多个人工智能代理也证实了这一点。他告诉主持人罗布·尼尔森，他“通过多个人工智能平台”“人工智能”了调查报告。 “我把它通过人工智能，”他说，“它说了 59 次，它[原文如此]说，‘你的调查结果是什么？’没有任何人工智能实例表明会发现性骚扰。”人工智能聊天机器人是出了名的阿谀奉承，经常告诉用户他们想听什么。考德威尔似乎不太可能希望听到人工智能证实他从事性骚扰的调查结果。 [媒体：https://www.tiktok.com/@njpbs/video/7692204986423414046?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc]
